## What this book deliberately does not do

This is a biology book. It does not catalogue software, benchmark tools, or teach
pipelines — that work is done well elsewhere, and duplicating it would both waste
effort and date the book quickly. The landscape as of November 2026:

### Tool catalogues

- [**long-read-tools.org**](https://long-read-tools.org/) — Ritchie Lab (WEHI)
  catalogue of long-read analysis tools, including a transcriptomics category.
  Actively curated, accepts submissions.
- [**awesome-alternative-splicing**](https://github.com/HussainAther/awesome-alternative-splicing)
  — a curated splicing tool list. Note it has not been updated since 2018 and
  predates the long-read era; useful mainly as a record of the short-read
  toolkit.

### Methods training

- [**rnabio.org**](https://rnabio.org/) — Griffith Lab RNA-seq course, usable
  standalone, with a module on isoform analysis and assembly.
- [**EBI: Long-read RNA-seq analysis**](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/training/materials/introduction-to-rna-seq-materials/qc-dwnstream-analysis/long-read-rna-seq-analysis/)
  — part of EBI's *Introduction to RNA-seq and functional interpretation*.
- [**Galaxy Training Network: differential isoform expression**](https://training.galaxyproject.org/training-material/topics/transcriptomics/tutorials/differential-isoform-expression/tutorial.html)
  — hands-on isoform switching.

### Databases and knowledge bases

Where this book makes a biological case, these are where a reader goes to look up
a specific gene or isoform.

- [**APPRIS**](https://appris.bioinfo.cnio.es/) — principal isoform selection,
  plus annotation of known functional alternative isoforms.
- [**MANE**](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/refseq/MANE/) — matched RefSeq/Ensembl
  representative transcripts; discussed critically in
  [the cataloguing chapter](09-catalogs.qmd).
- [**GENCODE**](https://www.gencodegenes.org/) — reference transcript annotation.
- **ASpdb**, **IsoProDB**, **SPLISOFORMS** — protein-isoform-level knowledge
  bases integrating structure, domains, disorder and NMD annotation.
- [**isopedia**](https://github.com/zhengxinchang/isopedia) — read-level indexing
  across large numbers of long-read transcriptomes.

### Adjacent communities

- [**Proteoform Alliance**](https://ctdp.org/) (formerly the Consortium for
  Top-Down Proteomics, renamed October 2026) and the
  [**Human Proteoform Project**](https://www.science.org/doi/10.1126/sciadv.abk0734)
  — the same argument made one level down, at the protein level. Natural allies:
  a transcript isoform that is never translated into a distinct proteoform, and a
  proteoform with no transcript-level explanation, are each other's open
  questions.
